stem: Which line suggests that Alejandro is sensitive to the feelings of others?

options.label: A
options.text: And she looks a lot worse than she did yesterday, he didn't say.

options.label: B
options.text: Why an old lady would come to ski or practice extreme sports was beyond him.

options.label: C
options.text: Dr. Alejandro Benetti shook his head in frustration.

options.label: D
options.text: "Well, I know what kills them, and how to keep that from happening."
